name: FRITZ!Box
description: Imports the FRITZ!Box (model, firmware, serial number) into the knowledge graph through TR-064 and lists the devices in the home network for AI clients; optionally imports active devices with "wired to" or "uplink" to the box. Settings: url (e.g. http://192.168.178.1:49000), username and password (a FRITZ!Box user with the right "FRITZ!Box settings"), optional import_hosts (yes to import devices). TR-064 must be enabled under Home Network → Network → Network Settings.

mcpTools.name: fritz.sync
mcpTools.description: Import the FRITZ!Box (and, if enabled, its active devices) into the knowledge graph now.

mcpTools.name: fritz.hosts
mcpTools.description: Devices known to the FRITZ!Box: name, IP, MAC, connection (LAN or Wi-Fi) and whether they are online.
